roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator (SDC) / Infection Control Nurse
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator (SDC) / Infection Control Nurse to join a leading skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, providing an excellent opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact on staff education and patient safety.
In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs to ensure our team maintains the highest standards of care. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, safeguarding the health and well-being of both residents and staff.
If you are a proactive and compassionate nurse with a passion for teaching and maintaining a safe environment, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to excellence and continuous improvement.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or nursing education
Proven experience in infection prevention and control within a healthcare setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care and infection control
